independent_computation.question_restated: Does any Malphite cast in the rotation depend on (require, consume, or is empowered by) another Malphite cast? If not, every per-cast dependency ledger must be empty.

step_1_enumerate_casts_from_cached_wiki_.dependency: NONE. Self movement-speed gain is derived from the target's slow, not from any other Malphite cast.

step_1_enumerate_casts_from_cached_wiki_.damage_rows: Empowered next attack: Additional Physical Damage 30/40/50/60/70 (+20% AP) (+15% armor); 5s cone on-hit: Physical Damage 15/25/35/45/55 (+30% AP) (+15% armor)
step_1_enumerate_casts_from_cached_wiki_.conditional_terms: Passive Bonus Armor 10/15/20/25/30% armor, 'tripled while Granite Shield is active' -> Increased Bonus Armor 30/45/60/75/90% armor
step_1_enumerate_casts_from_cached_wiki_.dependency: NONE on another CAST. The armor passive is always-on (a passive, never cast) and its tripling is gated on the P innate shield's state, not on a cast. The empowered attack rides basic attacks, which are autos, not casts.

step_1_enumerate_casts_from_cached_wiki_.damage_rows: Magic Damage 60/95/130/165/200 (+60% AP) (+40% armor); Cripple Strength 30/35/40/45/50%
step_1_enumerate_casts_from_cached_wiki_.conditional_terms: none - the armor term reads Malphite's current armor stat, which no Malphite CAST modifies

step_2_setup_consume_edge_test.method: The F3 taxonomy (data/worklists/f3-task.md, deliverable 1a) defines a cast dependency as an APPLICATION row preceding a CONSUME row: application markers (poison/blemish/stack/mark/amp/slow/root/stun/on-hit) must precede consumers (enhanced/consume/detonate/bonus-vs/X-stack/%missing). An edge exists only when BOTH sides are present.

keyword_scan_over_Malphite_abilities_jso.stack: 2 hits, both non-mechanical: E note 'The cripple stacks multiplicatively with other sources of attack speed reductions'; W note 'The passive's bonus armor stacks with an instance of recursion'
keyword_scan_over_Malphite_abilities_jso.empower: 3 hits, all W -> BASIC ATTACK (auto) empowerment, not cast->cast

step_2_setup_consume_edge_test.conclusion: Applications exist but nothing consumes them. No Malphite ability deals bonus damage versus slowed, crippled, or airborne targets. Edge count = 0. This scenario is a clean negative control: a naive detector keying on 'slow'/'on-hit' alone would false-positive; the correct answer is zero.

step_3_other_candidate_edge_families_rul.candidates: W passive bonus armor (feeds E's +40% armor and W's own +15% armor terms); Q self movement speed
step_3_other_candidate_edge_families_rul.ruled_out_because: W's armor is a PASSIVE, granted without casting, so casting W neither creates nor precedes the armor term E reads. Q's movement speed is non-damaging. No buff-before-damage cast ordering constraint exists.

step_3_other_candidate_edge_families_rul.candidates: P Granite Shield tripling W's passive armor (10-30% -> 30-90% armor)
step_3_other_candidate_edge_families_rul.ruled_out_because: Granite Shield is innate ('Innate - Granite Shield'), targeting 'Passive'. A passive-state condition is not a cast dependency; nothing in the rotation can cast it.

step_3_other_candidate_edge_families_rul.quote: W note: 'The empowered attack: ... Prevents Malphite from casting Seismic Shard and Ground Slam during its windup.'
step_3_other_candidate_edge_families_rul.ruled_out_because: This is a NEGATIVE timing exclusion on the shared cast timeline (already handled by mutual exclusion in _schedule_shared_casts per math-foundations S1.1), not a 'requires X first' dependency. It changes no damage term.

step_3_other_candidate_edge_families_rul.quote: W: 'Malphite empowers his next basic attack within 6 seconds ...' and 'basic attacks on-hit for the next 5 seconds are empowered to trigger a cone'
step_3_other_candidate_edge_families_rul.ruled_out_because: The dependent event is an AUTO ATTACK, not a cast. The leaf is /rotation/dependencies over cast entries; the W rider damage is attributed to W itself. No cast in the rotation requires a prior cast.

step_4_the_count_seven_is_consistent.quoted_rule: docs/math-foundations.md S1.1: 'Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline ... an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (_schedule_shared_casts). With c_i the effective cooldown of ability i, the cast epochs of a solo ability are 0, c_i, 2c_i, ...'
step_4_the_count_seven_is_consistent.worked_schedule: Max ranks, zero ability haste, 10 s window. Cached cooldowns: Q 8.0, W 8.0 (rank 5), E 7.0 (rank 5), R 100 (rank 3). Cast times: Q 0.25, W none, E 0.2419, R none. Shared timeline, greedy: t=0.00 R; t=0.00 Q (ends 0.25); t=0.25 W; t=0.25 E (ends 0.49); E ready 7.25 -> cast; Q ready 8.25 -> cast; W ready 8.25 -> cast at 8.50; R ready at 100 -> not recast. Casts starting inside T=10: R, Q, W, E, E, Q, W = 7.
step_4_the_count_seven_is_consistent.conclusion: Seven scheduled casts => seven per-cast ledgers. The cardinality is arithmetically reproducible from the cached cooldowns plus the shared-timeline rule; the CONTENT of each ledger must be empty by steps 2-3.

independent_computation.result: All seven per-cast dependency ledgers are correctly EMPTY. Malphite has zero cast->cast setup/consume, buff-first, or gating edges; his four abilities are order-independent for damage (total = Q + W-rider + E + R regardless of order, subject only to cooldowns and the shared-timeline mutual exclusion).

sources_quoted.quote: Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (_schedule_shared_casts). With c_i the effective cooldown of ability i, the cast epochs of a solo ability are 0, c_i, 2c_i, ...

DETECT setup/consume edges automatically from the ability rows + module metadata: an ability whose row names indicate application (poison/blemish/stack/mark/amp/slow/root/stun/on-hit) must precede abilities that consume (enhanced/consume/detonate/bonus-vs/X-stack/%missing)
FALLBACK: a champion with NO detectable edge and flat abilities keeps the certified/DEFAULT order with a rationale that says exactly that (data-driven, honest).

caveats: The golden baseline itself (scripts/golden_baseline.json) was NOT read, per runbook isolation; the old/new values are taken from the question statement.

The exact serialization shape of a 'ledger' is not derivable from data/ alone. This receipt certifies the SEMANTIC content (every ledger empty) and shows the cast count seven is reproducible from cached cooldowns + the S1.1 shared-timeline rule under a 10 s max-rank zero-haste window; if the scenario's window or haste differs, the count could differ while the empty content stands.

Materializing a previously absent leaf is only correct if the field is intended to be always-present rather than omitted-when-empty; on the substance (no dependencies exist), empty is the right content, and an explicit empty ledger is the more honest receipt than silence.
